title: 第一章 黄泉路
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

浓雾绵延，阴风低号。

无叶之花若隐若现，团团暗红，犹似陈血。

“我不甘心，不甘心！”

黄泉路走到一半时，秦勉听到与她同行的女子，恨意森森地开口。

秦勉没有回应她。

行在二人前面的老妇，转头温言道：“这位娘子，吾等今日同路去奈何桥，也算有缘。老身劝你一句，阎君既然判了咱们无罪无孽，可入轮回投胎，这辈子的债，便让它烟消云散吧。”

人死之后，亡魂入鬼门关时，虽能辨出男女老幼、高矮胖瘦、神情悲喜，但外表看不出是否死于外伤。

唯余金簪、玉佩等通行阴阳之物，暂时还粘在魂魄上。

那出言相劝的老妇，神态安详，玉钗金环，一看就是富贵人家无忧无虑的阿太。

而一叠声喊着“我不甘心”的女子，因死于赘婿与婢女的合伙谋害，神情间怨念毕露。

“呵呵，”女子冲老妇冷哼道，“你倒是说得轻巧。未经他人黄连苦，莫劝别个学你笑。你老人家，一辈子锦衣玉食、多福长寿，自然连咽气都咽得心甘情愿，却少来聒噪于我！”

被结结实实地呛回来，老妇的面色一僵。

然则已然将豁达架子摆了出来，总不好立时就转为气咻咻的争吵腔调，唯有憋回去，继续慈眉善目、不与无礼者计较的态度。

女子恶狠狠地回敬完老妇，转头看向秦勉，倒是收敛了戾色。

她生前乃是蜀地织锦大号的掌柜，最爱观察年轻小娘子。

冥帝于阎罗殿审问时，都是一对一，亡魂们不知彼此的渊源。上了黄泉路后，秦勉又沉默寡言。

蜀锦女掌柜不免好奇，这十八九岁的妙龄姑娘，发髻间亦有金花，五官更是生得不寒碜，但面皮又黑又糙，纵使眼神偶有凌厉闪过，人却安静得像狩猎中的花豹。

不知啥来头？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Thick fog lingers and the wind whistles low.

The leafless flowers are looming and dark red, like old blood.

"I'm not willing to give in, I'm not willing to give in!"

Halfway through the Huangquan Road, Qin Mian heard the woman walking with her speak with hatred.

Qin Mian didn't respond to her.

The old woman walking in front of the two of them turned her head and said warmly: "Madam, we are going to Naihe Bridge together today, which is considered a fate. I would like to advise you, since Lord Yan has sentenced us to be innocent and innocent, we can enter reincarnation, and let the debts of this life disappear."

After a person dies, when the soul enters the gate of hell, although it can be distinguished as male, female, old and young, tall, short, fat and thin, with sad and happy expressions, it cannot be seen from the appearance whether it died of external injuries.

Only gold hairpins, jade pendants and other yin and yang objects are still stuck to the soul for the time being.

The old woman who gave the advice had a calm expression and a jade hairpin and gold ring. At first glance, she looked like a carefree wife from a wealthy family.

And a group of women who shouted "I am not willing to accept it" died because of the conspiracy between their husband-in-law and their maid, and their expressions were full of resentment.

"Haha," the woman snorted coldly at the old woman, "You put it lightly. Don't persuade others to laugh like you without others suffering. You old man, you have lived a long and well-fed life, and naturally you even swallowed your breath willingly, but you don't come to make noises to me!"

After being choked back, the old woman's face froze.

However, once you have put on an open-minded air, it is not easy to turn into an angry and quarrelsome tone immediately. You can only hold it back and continue to be kind and not care about the rude person.

After the woman replied fiercely to the old woman, she turned to look at Qin Mian, but her expression became calmer.

During her lifetime, she was the shopkeeper of a large brocade shop in Shu, and she loved observing young ladies the most.

When Emperor Hades interrogated them in the Hall of Hell, they were all one-on-one, and the dead souls did not know each other's origins.After going to Huangquan Road, Qin Mian became taciturn again.

The female shopkeeper of Shu Brocade couldn't help but be curious. This young girl of eighteen or nineteen years old had gold flowers in her bun. Her facial features were not shabby, but her face was dark and rough. Even though her eyes occasionally flashed sharply, she was as quiet as a leopard during a hunt.

Don't know where it comes from?
